questions.q: What are Jacob's blessings over his sons in Genesis 49?
choices: What would befall each tribe in their day and in the last days
questions.explain: They help determine who the tribes are and where they would be found today.

choices: He went up to his father's couch
questions.explain: His birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph (1 Chronicles 5:1).

questions.q: Who is Shiloh in 'The sceptre shall not depart from Judah... until Shiloh come'?
choices: Christ, the peaceful one, of the tribe of Judah
questions.explain: Unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

questions.q: Which tribe 'shall dwell at the haven of the sea'?
questions.explain: In this teaching, the so-called Mayan Indians, with the Panama Canal in their land.

questions.q: Of which tribe is it said 'a troop shall overcome him: but he shall overcome at the last'?
questions.explain: In this teaching, the so-called North American Indian, rising back up in the last days.
